name: cli-init
body: `kalide init [path]` in the current directory creates `slides/` with one valid starter slide, an empty `assets/` directory for images, and a valid `kalide.yaml`. With no argument it also creates the project's minimal local `templates/` directory (see cli-init-minimal-seed). When the optional `path` argument is given it names an external template library (see external-template-library): init writes `templates: <path>` into `kalide.yaml`, writes NO local `templates/`, and validates the library at `path` fail-fast (templates-dir-validation) BEFORE writing anything — an invalid or missing library aborts with a clear error naming the path, a non-zero exit and nothing written. The path is stored as given (a relative path stays relative, resolved against the deck root). AC: immediately after a no-arg init, `kalide start` validates cleanly and serves the starter slide; after `kalide init ../lib` against a valid library, `kalide start` serves from `../lib`; `kalide init ../bad-lib` fails before writing anything.
